notes.title: Free demo, Arabic text support, and a new Casual difficulty update!
notes.notes:
Did you say zombies?! A free demo of Dead Rising Deluxe Remaster is available now for new players to try catching the big scoop and survive the various dangers of the lavish Willamette Parkview Mall.

The latest title update adds Arabic text support and a new Casual difficulty for those who want to focus on uncovering the truth while dodging the zombie hordes.

Try the demo now!

notes.title: Patch #4 Now Available (Oct. 14)
notes.notes:
Hello Dead Rising fans,

Today, we are releasing a patch which will address the crash on boot issue some of you are still experiencing, as well as an issue affecting those of you playing the game in Russian. We want to say thank you to the community for providing us with information that led to the fixes for the crash on boot issue. It was a bug which was easy to fix but hard to find, and continued support has paid off. The full change list is below:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue which would cause the game to crash on boot for players running the game from a hard drive with a sector size that is different from their C Drive
[*]Fixed an issue which was causing the game to crash in a specific area when playing in Russian.
[/list]
We also want to comment on some of the issues people are having when trying to force SLI and Crossfire to work. Some players have set up their systems to force usage of both GPUs by default, and some players have tried to force SLI/Crossfire ON while playing DR3. While this can benefit some games, DR3 PC does not make use of dual-GPUs. If your system is set to force dual-GPU usage when playing games, you can expect to see lower frame rates when compared to not forcing this setting.

The Dead Rising Team

[u][b]Change log[/b][/u][olist]
[*]Increased the default playback volume of the game.
[*]Added two extra outfits and one car skin:
-	Ken Masters outfit
-	Battle-hardened Nick outfit
-	Custom muscle car skin
[/olist]
=======================================================
Hello Dead Rising fans,

We have a quick update on top of Patch #2 that went live a couple of days ago.

Today's update, Patch #3, increases the overall volume of the game to better match the sound output level of the Windows sound system.  In addition, the team has included a little gift as a token of appreciation to thank the community who has provided constructive and helpful feedback.  The feedback certainly helped the dev team narrow down, reproduce, and fix some of the egregious random crashes and crash-on-boot issues that has affected a subset of users.

For bug report and feedback specific to Patch #3, please post [b][u][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/265550/discussions/0/613937306687292094/]HERE[/url][/u][/b].

Thank you for continued support.  

Dead Rising Team

notes.title: Patch #2 Now Available (SEPT. 24)
notes.notes:
[u][b]Change log[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem which was causing the game to crash after booting for many NVidia Optimus players
[*]Fixed an issue which was causing some NVidia Optimus systems to enumerate video devices incorrectly
[*]Made a change which improves performance and stability for some users
[/list]
=======================================================
Hello Dead Rising fans,

Thanks again for your continued support.  Your feedback has allowed the development team to reproduce and implement a fix that should address remaining Optimus laptop crashing issues that occurred on certain GPU/chipset combination.

The patch has been tested against the new [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/265550/discussions/0/613936673449769041/]GeForce 344.11 WHQL drivers[/url].  We recommended that you update to the latest driver as it contains fixes that address other stability issues.

Please provide feedback if you notice new issues by using the feedback guideline outlined on the official DR3 Steam forum, [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/265550/discussions/0/613937306589454361/]HERE[/url][/b].

Thank you,

- Dead Rising Team
